jobs.title: Entry-Level Telecom Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Entry\-Level Telecommunications Sales Representative**

**3C Innovations is hiring Entry\-Level Telecommunications Sales Representatives** to join our customer\-focused sales team.

If you enjoy meeting people, building relationships, explaining products and services, and working toward measurable goals, this opportunity offers the chance to develop valuable sales and business skills while building a long\-term career.

This is a **customer\-facing telecommunications sales position**. In this role, you will engage directly with customers, learn about their needs, present relevant telecommunications products and services, conduct demonstrations and presentations, and help customers understand available solutions in a retail setting.

**What You’ll Do**

* Engage directly with customers through professional, informative sales conversations in a retail environment.
* Identify customer needs and recommend telecommunications products and services that are relevant to those needs.
* Present product and service features, benefits, and pricing clearly and accurately.
* Conduct product demonstrations and customer presentations.
* Develop and maintain positive customer relationships through consistent follow\-up and service.
* Support new customer acquisition and account growth through a consultative sales approach.
* Answer customer questions and address concerns professionally.
* Track customer feedback and market information to help improve sales strategies.
* Participate in approved promotional campaigns, events, and customer engagement activities.
* Represent 3C Innovations professionally when interacting with customers and business partners.
* Work collaboratively with the sales team while taking responsibility for individual performance goals.
* Complete required training and participate in ongoing coaching and professional development.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* A professional, customer\-focused approach.
* Motivation to learn and develop sales skills.
* Comfort speaking with a wide range of customers.
* Goal\-oriented and organized work habits.
* Ability to accept coaching and apply feedback.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
* Previous experience in sales, customer service, hospitality, retail, promotions, restaurants, events, or another customer\-facing role is helpful but not required.
* Multilingual abilities are welcome.
* We value potential, professionalism, reliability, and willingness to learn as well as prior experience.

**Training and Career Development**

3C Innovations provides paid training and ongoing development designed to help employees build practical sales, communication, customer\-service, and leadership skills.

As you develop in the role, opportunities may include:

* Management and leadership training.
* Increased responsibility based on performance and business needs.
* Coaching and team\-development opportunities.
* Professional development workshops and networking events.
* Opportunities for advancement into leadership and management positions.
* Opportunities to participate in business\-related travel.
* Continued development in sales, customer relationships, and business operations.

Career advancement is based on performance, demonstrated skills, business needs, and available opportunities.

**Compensation**

**Hourly Wage: $17\.13–$30\.00 per hour, plus commissions and applicable bonuses.**

Employees are guaranteed at least their applicable hourly wages, including applicable overtime. When commission earnings exceed the applicable hourly wages for a pay period, employees are paid the higher commission amount in accordance with the company's commission program.

The average representative earns approximately **$800–$1,200 per week**, depending on individual sales performance and commissions.

The company also provides paid training and ongoing development.

**Schedule and Employment Details**

* **Employment Type:** Full\-time, W\-2
* **Schedule:** Thursday–Monday, 10:30 AM–7:00 PM, five days per week
* **Training:** Paid training, including applicable virtual and in\-person training
* **Scheduling:** Flexible scheduling options may be available after successful completion of training
* **Interview Process:** Virtual interview, followed by next steps in the hiring process
* **Career Development:** Leadership training, professional development, and advancement opportunities

**Benefits and Additional Opportunities**

This position is **not eligible for employer\-sponsored health insurance, retirement benefits, or paid leave benefits**. Any available employee perks or discounts will be explained during the hiring process.

Employees may also have opportunities to participate in professional development programs, networking events, and business\-related travel.

**Why Join 3C Innovations?**

This role is designed for individuals who want to develop practical business and sales experience while working in a structured, team\-oriented environment.

You will have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals, develop customer relationship and communication skills, take on additional responsibility as you grow, and pursue advancement opportunities based on performance and available positions.

**3C Innovations is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, genetic information, military service, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**To apply:** Submit your application to be considered for an interview. Interviews are available next day and conducted over Zoom.

jobs.title: Freight Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Join a Freight Company That Grew 10X in One Year**  

Location: Chicago / Lisle, IL  

Company: Amnex Solutions Corp  

Division: OTR \& Drayage  

Employment Type: Full\-Time  

**About Amnex Solutions**  

Amnex Solutions Corp is not a traditional freight brokerage.  

We are a rapidly growing transportation and logistics company specializing in OTR, drayage, and complex transportation solutions nationwide — and we have grown 10X over the last year.  

Our team moves fast, works hard, solves problems, and takes ownership. We have built a culture around people who would rather figure out how to make something happen than explain why it can't be done.  

Our customers rely on us for much more than simply finding a truck. They come to Amnex when they need solutions — whether that means sourcing capacity, developing a new lane, or designing an entirely new transportation strategy.  

We operate with an entrepreneurial mindset, and we want people who are excited by growth rather than intimidated by it.  

If you're looking for a place where you can build a serious book of business, make an impact, and grow alongside the company, you should talk to us.  

**The Opportunity**  

We are looking for an experienced Freight Sales Representative who knows how to hunt for business, build relationships, and turn opportunities into long\-term customers.  

You will have ownership over your business from the beginning — prospecting, quoting, developing lanes, sourcing carriers, managing shipments, and growing the account.  

But there's an important difference:  

As your book grows, Amnex will grow around you.  

If you become successful enough that managing operations starts taking time away from selling, we will add operational and carrier coverage support around your business so you can continue building.  

We want our best salespeople spending more time growing accounts — not getting buried under the success they created.  

**What You'll Do**  

Build Your Own Book of Business  

Prospect and develop new shipper relationships across OTR, drayage, and related transportation services.  

* 
Identify opportunities through phone, email, networking, referrals, and creative outreach.  
* 
Develop relationships with logistics managers, supply chain teams, manufacturers, importers, exporters, distributors, and other shippers.  
* 
Build lane strategies and pricing models designed to win profitable, repeatable freight.  
* 
Turn individual shipments into long\-term customer relationships.  
* 

Own the Freight  

You won't simply hand a customer off once the sale is made.  

You will understand the freight you're selling and make sure it gets executed correctly.  

Quote and price shipments.  

* 
Source and negotiate with carriers.  
* 
Book and manage loads.  
* 
Track freight proactively.  
* 
Solve problems before customers have to ask.  
* 
Communicate shipment updates and exceptions.  
* 
Ensure documentation and billing are completed correctly.  
* 

Build Carrier \& Customer Relationships  

Develop dependable carrier relationships across your core lanes.  

* 
Utilize RMIS, Carrier411, load boards, TMS technology, and Amnex's internal carrier network.  
* 
Maintain strong communication with customers and carriers.  
* 
Become the person your customers call when they need something handled.  
* 

**Help Build the Company**  

We're still growing — quickly.  

That means strong performers have an opportunity to influence how Amnex operates.  

You may work directly with company leadership on:  

New customer strategies  

* 
Large transportation projects  
* 
Pricing models  
* 
Carrier development  
* 
Automation  
* 
Technology  
* 
Operational improvements  
* 
New service offerings  
* 

We are looking for people who want to build, not just occupy a seat.  

**Who We're Looking For**  

You should have:  

2\+ years of freight brokerage, transportation sales, logistics, or account management experience.  

* 
Demonstrated ability to prospect and develop new customer relationships.  
* 
Experience managing freight in a cradle\-to\-grave environment.  
* 
Strong knowledge of OTR truckload, intermodal, drayage, or port operations.  
* 
Strong negotiation and communication skills.  
* 
Familiarity with TMS platforms, load boards, CRM systems, and carrier\-vetting tools.  
* 
Experience with platforms such as Turvo, DAT, Truckstop, RMIS, or Carrier411 is a plus.  
* 
The ability to operate independently without needing someone constantly telling you what to do next.  
* 

Most importantly, we're looking for someone with drive.  

Someone who follows up.  

Someone who keeps prospecting after a good month.  

Someone who sees a difficult transportation problem and thinks, \\"I can figure this out.\\"  

**This Role Probably Isn't for Everyone**  

If you're looking for a position where you inherit a comfortable book of business and simply maintain it, this probably isn't the right opportunity.  

If you're competitive, entrepreneurial, relationship\-driven, and excited by the idea of building something substantial inside a rapidly growing company, you'll fit in well here.  

Our culture has energy.  

We work hard. We move quickly. We joke around. We solve problems. And when someone on the team starts winning, we put resources behind them so they can win bigger.  

**Compensation \& Benefits**  

Competitive base salary  

* 
Uncapped commission  
* 
Performance bonuses and incentive opportunities  
* 
Health benefits  
* 
401(k)  
* 
Operational and carrier\-support resources as your book grows  
* 
Direct access to company leadership  
* 
Opportunity to build and lead a team  
* 
Advancement into senior sales, key account, or leadership positions  
* 

Your Ceiling Here Is Not a Job Title.  

Amnex grew approximately 10X in the last year, and we're building for the next stage now.
